verdict.rationale: Sai's core interaction model is natural-language tasking. Users describe work in plain English and Sai carries it out on a cloud computer or their own device, and developers can send plain-language tasks via the API. Saving a replayable skill is shown as a natural-language instruction, and workflow templates are ready-to-run prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
